fusions.name: Grip and Jab
fusions.desc: Grips the target and stings it 2 times, a strike that deals 4 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it 15% for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrung Out
fusions.desc: Seizes a target at or below 25% health; the blow deals 22 damage plus 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which is used up, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Plucked Clean
fusions.desc: Plucks up to 2 conditions off you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Steady Fingers
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that did not crit is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
